newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Netanyahu to visit Russia in February.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu to visit Russia in February.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is to make his first visit to Russia next February, his spokesman said on Monday.

The invitation to Netanyahu, who is attending a 54-nation Organisation for Security and Cooperation (OSCE) summit in Lisbon, came from Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomydrin during a meeting between the two leaders, the spokesman said.
Yitzhak Rabin, who was assassinated last year, became the first Israeli premier to visit Moscow when he went there in April 1994.
